items.title: Ramadan - Purpose of Fasting
items.excerpt: Fasting during Ramadan teaches us patience, empathy, and gratitude. It is a time to reflect on our blessings and connect with those less fortunate.
items.body:
Ramadan is the holy month in which Muslims around the world fast from dawn to sunset. But Ramadan is about much more than just not eating or drinking.

Fasting teaches us patience. When we feel hungry, we remember those who don't have enough food every day. Fasting teaches us empathy — we understand what it feels like to be hungry, and this makes us more generous and compassionate.

Ramadan is also a time for gratitude. We appreciate the food we have, the family around us, and the blessings in our lives. It is a month of prayer, kindness, and community.

When Ramadan ends, we celebrate Eid with joy and thankfulness. But the lessons of Ramadan stay with us all year long.
items.author: Aljazi Abdulla Alsowaidi

items.title: World Diabetes Day
items.excerpt: Diabetes affects millions of people worldwide. Understanding the disease and making healthy choices can help us protect ourselves and support those around us.
items.body:
World Diabetes Day is celebrated every year on November 14th. The day raises awareness about diabetes and how we can prevent it.

Diabetes is a condition where the body has trouble controlling the amount of sugar in the blood. There are two main types: Type 1, which people are born with, and Type 2, which can develop over time.

The good news is that we can reduce our risk of Type 2 diabetes by staying active, eating healthy meals, and drinking plenty of water. Small daily choices make a big difference.

On World Diabetes Day, let's remember to be kind and supportive to those living with diabetes, and to take care of our own health too.
items.author: Haya Hamad Al-hamar

items.title: What is Kindness?
items.excerpt: Kindness is more than just a word. It is a way of living that transforms how we treat each other and how we see the world around us.
items.body:
Kindness is one of the most powerful things we can share with others. It doesn't cost money, but it can mean everything to someone who needs it.

Kindness can be a simple smile. It can be listening when a friend needs to talk. It can be helping someone carry their books, or inviting someone to join a game at recess.

When we are kind, we make the world a better place — one small act at a time. And here's the best part: kindness grows. When someone experiences kindness, they are more likely to be kind to others.

So let's start today. Let's look for small ways to be kind. Because kindness is not just something we do — it's who we are.
items.author: Albayan Student

items.title: What is Cooperation?
items.excerpt: Cooperation means working together toward a shared goal. When we cooperate, we achieve more than we ever could alone, and we build stronger friendships.
items.body:
Cooperation is when we work together to reach a goal that we couldn't reach alone. It means listening to each other, sharing ideas, and helping when someone needs it.

In school, cooperation is everywhere. When a class project goes well, it's usually because students cooperated. When a sports team wins, it's because they played together. When a friendship is strong, it's because both people support each other.

Cooperation teaches us patience, respect, and teamwork. These are skills we'll use for the rest of our lives.

The next time you have a group project, remember: together, we can do more than we ever could apart.
items.author: Aisha Abulrahman Almarwani

items.title: Qatar's Beauty
items.excerpt: A poem celebrating the desert sands, the pearl-diving heritage, and the modern skyline of our beloved nation, Qatar.
items.body:
A golden desert, endless and wide,
Where pearls once slept in the ocean tide.
Dhow boats sailed with the morning breeze,
And pearl divers worked with the greatest ease.

Now tall towers touch the sky,
While tradition stays, and never says goodbye.
From the Souq Waqif's glowing light,
To the skyline shining in the night.

Qatar, our home, so proud and true,
Our hearts belong, always, to you.
items.author: Maryam Almohannadi

items.title: World Children's Day Celebration
items.excerpt: A report on how Albayan students celebrated World Children's Day with joy, activities, and reflection on children's rights around the world.
items.body:
World Children's Day is celebrated every year on November 20th. It's a day to celebrate children — their rights, their voices, and their dreams.

At Albayan, we celebrated with a full day of activities. Students created posters about children's rights, wore colorful clothes, and participated in games and performances.

In the morning assembly, we learned about children around the world who face difficult challenges. We discussed what we can do to help — even in small ways.

The day reminded us that every child deserves love, safety, education, and a chance to dream. And that we are lucky to have all of these — and to be able to share them with others.
items.author: Haya Alhamar

items.title: School Trip to Qatar Scouts and Guides
items.excerpt: An account of our memorable visit to the Qatar Scouts and Guides, where students learned outdoor skills, teamwork, and the spirit of scouting.
items.body:
Last month, our class went on an exciting trip to the Qatar Scouts and Guides center. It was a day full of learning, teamwork, and fun.

When we arrived, our guide showed us around the camp. We learned how to pitch a tent, tie different types of knots, and read a compass. We even learned how to make a small fire safely (with teacher supervision, of course).

The best part was the teamwork activities. We had to cross an imaginary river using only a few planks of wood — and we had to work together. It showed us that success comes from cooperation.

By the end of the day, we were tired but happy. The trip reminded us that learning doesn't only happen in classrooms.
items.author: Maria Abdulaziz

items.title: Teacher's Day Report
items.excerpt: A tribute to our wonderful teachers at Albayan, capturing the celebrations, thank-yous, and heartfelt moments of World Teacher's Day.
items.body:
World Teacher's Day is a special day to thank our teachers for everything they do. At Albayan, we celebrated with a full day of surprises.

In the morning, students greeted teachers with flowers and cards. Some classes prepared songs and poems. Others wrote heartfelt thank-you letters.

Our teachers work so hard to help us learn and grow. They wake up early, prepare lessons, grade homework, and most importantly, they believe in us.

So on World Teacher's Day — and every day — we say thank you. Thank you for teaching us, guiding us, and making our school a happy place.
items.author: Badriya, Shahd, Dhabia
